roots.name: T52–53 · Minimap design contract / provisional
text: SONG MINIMAP / ANOTHER VIEW OF THE SAME ARRANGEMENT
Confirmed: top-level Song has an additional Minimap mode. Compact lanes show activity across up to 16 tracks, aligned by musical time. This adds no Pattern aggregate and no separate sequence.

Exploratory: 32-bar viewport, note-density marks, bar ruler, zoom, follow, focus border and per-phrase separators. Screenshot data is illustrative; exact encodings and controller shortcut remain open.

Focus retains song/track/chain-use/phrase-use identity. Select / Shift Right opens the corresponding chain; multiselect still opens Expanded. Switching views preserves playback and the current occurrence.
Runtime: one shared musical clock, independent track cursor stacks. Jumps/repeats need a bounded projection policy; never assume equal arrangement row lengths or predict infinite loops.
Navigation retained: Song Shift Up → Settings; Shift Down → Mixer. Expanded Shift Left → Song. Mode switching is a view action and must not rewrite NoteData.
